Lawsuit Alleges ChatGPT Fueled Delusions and Self-Harm

A man in California has filed a lawsuit alleging that ChatGPT, an AI chatbot, fueled his delusions and contributed to self-harm. The man has a diagnosed bipolar disorder. OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT, stated that the AI is trained to recognize and respond to signs of emotional distress and guide users toward support.
